decisions.context: Where the merge runs. Notes are encrypted at rest on the server.
options: On each device. Content stays encrypted end to end, but two devices may merge the same pair twice.
On the server. One merge per change, but the server has to read note content.
decisions.why: Reading note content on the server would break end to end encryption.
decisions.revisitWhen: Merges on slow phones take longer than a second.

decisions.context: What a merge compares. A note is a list of paragraphs, and a paragraph can be several screens long.
options: Paragraphs. Simple to show as a conflict, but two edits to one long paragraph conflict.
Sentences. Fewer conflicts, but a conflict view per sentence is hard to read.
decisions.why: A paragraph is what a person reads as one piece, so a conflict at that size is easy to settle.
decisions.revisitWhen: More than 1% of syncs end in a conflict.
